title.en: An Act Exempting Certain Bonds of the "Manila Railroad Company of the Philippine Islands" From Taxation.
title.orig: An Act Exempting Certain Bonds of the "Manila Railroad Company of the Philippine Islands" From Taxation.

text.en:
Any bonds hereafter issued by the "Manila Railroad Company of the Philippine Islands," and all
income directly derived therefrom shall be exempt from the payment of any tax of the Government of the
Philippine Islands or any division or political subdivision of the same.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 23, 1920.
